name: GP Memphis Cellulose Mill - Memphis TN

fieldNotes.location: Roster geocode (35.1486,-90.0519) landed in downtown Memphis, ~5 km off (APPROXIMATE, 1952 m flagged). Web research resolved the mill to 920 Scott Rd in the Binghampton neighborhood; the 1001 Tillman St address is the separate GP Cellulose Technology & Innovation Center office. Mill complex located via satellite at ~35.1565,-89.9620.
fieldNotes.facility: Large multi-building urban industrial cellulose mill - the former Buckeye Cellulose / Buckeye Technologies cotton-linter pulp plant, acquired by GP in 2013. GP announced permanent closure of the Memphis Cellulose mill in October 2025 (~130 layoffs).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Complex is fully enclosed by chain-link perimeter fencing (verified along multiple street frontages in Street View). Controlled vehicle gates observed at the fenced parking/office entrance. Treated as a controlled truck gate; exact dedicated truck lane not isolated - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No distinct standalone guard booth confirmed at a truck lane; office/admin building sits at the main entry. Classified remoteGs true - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Urban site - mill fronts onto city streets with residential blocks directly across; a truck queue at the gate would spill onto a public street.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock clusters on different building faces plus rail-served receiving area; shipping and receiving physically separate.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 14+ distinct buildings - processing, warehouses, pole-barn storage, office, plus a large rail/tank-car yard.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active rail line runs the full length of the west side; rail tank cars and rail equipment visible in the on-site yard.
fieldNotes.scale: A truck scale is operationally expected at a pulp mill of this type and era; not pinpointed in imagery - flagged low-confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large paved yard along the rail holds trailers and rail cars - functions as a drop/storage yard.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense urban Memphis - surrounded on the east and south by residential blocks; clearly Urban.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Multiple dock banks across aging buildings; ~8 trailers visible plus additional doors - banded 10-25, medium confidence.
